audit: LEARNED / DOMAIN-INVARIANT KNOWN-GT REPRESENTATION AUDIT V1

sourceWorkCanvas.semantics: exact canonical work canvas already frozen/reproduced by VF0; no learned-specific preprocessing before resize

referenceWorkCanvas.source: exact Dashen FINE_Z=5 tile pixels loaded by the unchanged replay/reference path
referenceWorkCanvas.geometry: exact VF0 candidate x/y/angle/radius plus inherited symmetric pose tuple
referenceWorkCanvas.pixelMapping: for destination pixel (x,y), mid=95.5, nx=(x-mid)/96, ny=(y-mid)/96; rx=cx+(nx*cos(angle)-ny*sin(angle))*radius; ry=cy+(nx*sin(angle)+ny*cos(angle))*radius
referenceWorkCanvas.sampling: bilinear independently on raw RGB8 tile-canvas channels; clamp 0..255 then round to nearest integer

preNormalization.hash: SHA-256 over contiguous row-major 196x196x3 RGB bytes

normalization.source: facebookresearch/dinov2 dinov2/data/transforms.py at frozen source commit

featureExtraction.layer: final backbone output only via forward_features
featureExtraction.clsToken: extract and conformance-record; not mixed into L1/L2/L3
featureExtraction.registerTokens: extract for conformance only; exclude from all similarity samples
featureExtraction.cosineNormalization: torch.nn.functional.normalize(..., p=2, dim=-1) exactly where specified per head

L1.name: GLOBAL_PATCH_MEAN_COSINE
L1.definition: arithmetic mean of the 196 final-layer patch tokens per image; L2-normalize resulting 384-vector; cosine(queryMean,referenceMean)

L2.name: ALIGNED_PATCH_COSINE
L2.definition: L2-normalize every query/reference patch token independently; cosine corresponding patch i; uniform arithmetic mean over exactly 196 aligned positions

L3.name: BIDIRECTIONAL_PATCH_CHAMFER_COSINE
L3.definition: L2-normalize all 196 query/reference patch tokens; mean over query-token maximum cosine to any reference token and mean over reference-token maximum cosine to any query token; score=0.5*(qToR+rToQ)

conformance.repeatedEmbedding: bitwise identical on the frozen CPU runtime

candidateLocked.populationPerControl: exact VF0 GT plus all 8 exact VF0 WRONG candidates
candidateLocked.rank: 1 + count(WRONG score strictly greater than GT); ties reported separately

poseGrid.symmetry: identical complete grid around GT and every frozen WRONG base candidate
poseGrid.selection: independently choose maximum score under the same learned head for each base candidate

classes.DR-STABLE: GT preferred both and absolute margin change <= 0.10
classes.DR-PARTIAL: GT preferred both and absolute margin change > 0.10

clauses: successes include at least one Qinghe and at least one Kaifeng
General drift is DR-STABLE or DR-PARTIAL

retrieval.conditional: only learned local survivors; zero local survivors => SKIPPED_NO_LOCAL_SURVIVORS
retrieval.population: same deterministic all 424 exact Dashen z5 tile centers frozen by descriptor V1/V2; sorted (tileY,tileX), center=(tileX*256+128,tileY*256+128)
retrieval.head: same exact L1/L2/L3 head that survived locally; no score changes
retrieval.pose: same exact inherited symmetric 81-pose grid at every sampled center
retrieval.gtNeighborhood: sampled center nearest independent GT; learned representation cannot redefine
retrieval.rank: 1 + count(non-GT sampled centers score > GT-center score); ties separately counted
retrieval.falseBasin: 8-connected components in z5 tile-index space among centers above GT
retrieval.runtime: warm-up first 10 candidate-pose evaluations; report median and p95 inference/runtime

retrievalSafety.safe: no newly stronger persistent sampled wrong basin relative to the GT-neighborhood ordering under the surviving head
retrievalSafety.unsafe: persistent false-basin condition is established by wrong-above-GT connected concentration and repeated dominance sufficient to classify learned retrieval as unsafe

stress40Frame.conditional: only retrieval-safe learned survivors; otherwise SKIPPED_NO_RETRIEVAL_SAFE_SURVIVORS
stress40Frame.populationAndPose: unchanged learned retrieval 424 centers and same 81-pose grid

precedence: LR1 only when all local survivor, Fang, drift, retrieval safety, and conditional stress safety requirements pass
otherwise LR3 if an unsafe persistent false-basin condition is established
otherwise LR2 if material partial positive evidence exists
verdict.materialPartialPositiveEvidence: at least one learned head produces positive GT-vs-WRONG margin on at least one owner unique control or Fang in either locked or symmetric-81 evaluation, without satisfying LR1 and without LR3

historicalLearnedDiagnostics.reason: this audit is prospective on immutable VF0 candidates with preregistered model/heads, mandatory General drift and Fang
